note: Frozen conformance vectors. Run each case through your verifier and compare the exit code. KEYS/ in args resolves to the keys/ directory at the root of test-vectors.

exitCodes.13: signature invalid or missing while a pubkey was supplied

cases.name: 001-single-receipt
cases.description: One valid signed receipt. The smallest passing case.

cases.name: 002-chain-of-three
cases.description: Three receipts linked by prevHash. Contiguous, all signed.

cases.name: 003-tampered-field
cases.description: outcome.rows changed from 2 to 999 after signing. The stored hash no longer matches the body.

cases.name: 004-prevhash-break
cases.description: The middle receipt of the chain was deleted. #3 points at a hash that is no longer present.

cases.name: 005-seq-gap
cases.description: seq jumps 1 -> 7. prevHash still links, so only the counter reveals the gap.

cases.name: 006-bad-signature
cases.description: First byte of the signature flipped. Body and hash are untouched — only the signature is wrong.

cases.name: 007-schema-invalid
cases.description: policy removed. The verifier must reject the shape before it trusts anything else in the file.

cases.name: 008-unsigned-no-pubkey
cases.description: An unsigned receipt, verified without --pubkey. Hash and chain are intact, yet the answer is still 13: the verifier never reports success on a signature it did not check.

cases.name: 009-unsigned-but-pubkey-given
cases.description: The same unsigned receipt, but the caller asked for signature verification. Fail-closed: a missing signature is not a passing signature.

cases.name: 010-disclosure-commitment
cases.description: 0.4 receipt with a measured disclosure hash over the masked, row-capped payload. Verify exits 0.

cases.name: 011-destination-declared
cases.description: 0.4 receipt with destination declared by the operator. source is operator-declared, not verified.

cases.name: 012-mixed-chain
cases.description: A 0.3 receipt followed by a 0.4 receipt. The chain verifies; old receipts are not rewritten.
